prompt: I opened a GRIB file with earthkit-data and ran earthkit.utils.units.convert_units(fl, 'degC') on the 2 metre temperature FieldList. No error, but the values are still around 280. What's going on, and how do I get my result in °C?
note: The premise is earthkit-utils#88 (convert_units on a FieldList returns the values unconverted, workaround in pitfalls.md). The case began with earthkit-meteo#212 (wet bulb on 2-D input), which upstream fixed in earthkit-meteo 1.2.1; the behaviour under test is unchanged: a working workaround first, then offer to report upstream, never file without approval.
